text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Love me♡ Love you♡ It's Loves Only You♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So many people are pushing me forward... 
Because they're supporting me, I can 
become strong♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
All the love I've received from everyone, 
I'll return it all in the form of massive 
victories♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
